## [1.3.0-dev.4](https://github.com/mohamedamrnady/anghami-patches/compare/v1.3.0-dev.3...v1.3.0-dev.4) (2026-10-06)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* stop server radio paths, never report shuffle ([f281e30](https://github.com/mohamedamrnady/anghami-patches/commit/f281e308c4a24aa6cc812266cf90951de26927af))

### ✨ New Features

* AMOLED black background in dark mode ([0280373](https://github.com/mohamedamrnady/anghami-patches/commit/0280373d3f295bab57585b584b4834dae3d43bb9))

patches.name: AMOLED black background
patches.description: Forces pure-black app background in dark mode (window_background_color -> #000000). Surfaces/cards keep stock greys; light mode untouched.

patches.name: Disable audio ads
patches.description: Forces AdSettings.noAd=true and PlayQueue.getDisableAds=true so songs are treated as ad-free locally. Client flag only.

patches.name: Header Play + Shuffle
patches.description: Playlist/album headers show Play + Shuffle instead of Shuffle + Edit/Follow/Like (functional LEAVECOLLAB, local-songs ADD_MORE and podcasts untouched). Pulls in 'Unforce shuffle'.

patches.name: Hide Gold features
patches.description: Forces Account.isGold/isGoldUser and all GoldUtilsKt.isGold overloads to false. Hides server-gated Gold UI instead of spoofing it.

patches.name: Hide shuffle badges
patches.description: Hides PLAYS IN SHUFFLE badges on playlist/album headers, feed cards, and rows. Cosmetic only.

patches.name: Hide upgrade upsell
patches.description: Hides the nav upgrade entry, header promo banner, feed upsell cards and AI MIX button model (gap-free), and settings subscribe banner. Server-driven UI the Plus spoof cannot remove.

patches.name: Hide upsell feature buttons
patches.description: Hides TRY SING ALONG karaoke upsell, disables the karaoke feature itself, and hides the player/playlist AI MIX buttons. Feature UI stays hidden rather than paywalled.

patches.name: LRCLIB lyrics fallback
patches.description: When the server returns truncated/empty lyrics, fetches the full text from LRCLIB (opt-in free source) into a separate cache. Native full lyrics and the Plus path are untouched.

patches.name: Lyrics options on play long-press
patches.description: Long-press play/pause for lyrics options (retry, LRCLIB search, synced/plain toggle, server version) instead of the sleep timer. Pulls in 'LRCLIB lyrics fallback'.

patches.name: Monet dynamic colors
patches.description: Replaces the static neon brand accents with wallpaper-based Monet dynamic colors (M3 Expressive primary/secondary/tertiary roles) on Android 12+. Older versions keep stock colors.

patches.name: Player theme
patches.description: Night-only player theme: removes the cover-art tint and paints the now-playing row, pills and action icons with the primary accent at night; day mode keeps the stock tinted player. Pulls in 'Player theme background' resources.

patches.name: Player theme background
patches.description: Makes the player background, text, icons and seekbar follow the app's day/night theme. Keeps the darker split below the progress bar. Pair with 'Player theme'.

patches.name: Remove popup promos
patches.description: No-ops the in-house popup funnel, the fullscreen startup dialog, and the flyer ad callback. Google SDK ads untouched.

patches.name: Spoof stock app signature
patches.description: Forces SignatureUtils.getAppSignature to hash with the stock cert prefix (he9B...kw=), so X-ANGH-APP-RGSIG matches a stock install. Salt/body hashing unchanged.

patches.name: Unforce shuffle
patches.description: Forces server shuffleOn=false at both sync points, never reports shuffle to the server, disables the pick-a-song radio redirect, enables shuffle buttons, and disarms the shuffle upsell dialog. Manual shuffle toggle and the header Shuffle button keep working.

patches.name: Unlock downloads
patches.description: No-ops download limit asserts, forces limited-plan=false and large offline caps (999999). Local gates only; the server still authorizes files.

patches.name: Unlock local Plus
patches.description: Forces Account.isPlus/isPlusUser=true, enablePlayerRestrictions=false, canPlayOfflineAndFree=true. Local UI/gating only; server premium checks remain.

patches.name: Unlock playback limits
patches.description: Disables skip and queue limits (skipLimitReached/queueRestrictionsEnabled=false, disable-flags=true). Local gates only.
